show.description: A high-voltage romantic drama about billionaire Amit Desai and his wife Jaya, whose marriage is breaking under betrayal, ego and family politics. Forced to stay together for Daadi’s sake, they become trapped in a dangerous battle of love, revenge and hidden passion, while manipulative Rekha tries to destroy Jaya and take her place.
